text:
[issue by GallonEmilien]
Hello, I'm encountering a NoClassDefFoundError when trying to launch the game in a development environment with Architectury API on NeoForge. The crash seems to be caused by a breaking change in a recent NeoForge beta version where BreakBlockEvent was likely moved or renamed.

Environment:

- Minecraft Version: 26.1
- NeoForge Version: 26.1.0.11-beta
- Architectury API Version: 20.0.5
- Architectury Loom: 1.14

The crash occurs during the initialization of ArchitecturyNeoForge, indicating that Architectury is attempting to reference a class that no longer exists at that location in this specific NeoForge build
